summary:
The Math Animation Engine project has been completely rebuilt from scratch. It features a custom tweening engine using requestAnimationFrame and a Manim-style visual aesthetic.
A sample 2D shear transformation lesson demonstrates the capabilities of the engine, including smoothly morphing coordinate grids, color-coded KaTeX equations, and a timeline controller.
The frontend has been ported to Tailwind CSS v4 to match the sleek dark theme requirements.
